headline: Weathered Expanse Grinds On; Callahan's Passage Falls Quiet
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse remains the war's hottest quarter, with thirteen events in the last two hours and sixty-two in twenty-four about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk; its nine squares now stand four Warden, three Colonial and two no-man's-land, a narrower Warden margin than the previous edition recorded. Fisherman's Row keeps up its contest at Eidolo and Black Well, one of its neutral squares returning to Warden colours for a line of three Warden to six Colonial. Stlican Shelf has likewise shifted to three Warden, five Colonial and one neutral, with Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost the busiest ground. Callahan's Passage, loudest of all by casualties, has gone quiet on the map board — no base events in six hours, though the day's returns there run near 9,872 Colonial and 12,305 Warden. Nevish Line stirs again at Grief Mother, while Mooring County's activity has eased about The Wind Hills, Wiccwalk and The Cut. Stema Landing and Palantine Berm have fallen still, and Colonials retain sole colours over the great majority of regions.
